# LeukLogic

> LeukLogic builds small software for businesses — Discord and Slack bots, automations, scheduled reports, internal tools, dashboards, and fast static websites — built by one person in days. Most projects run $100–$500, always at a fixed price quoted before work starts. Contact: tim@leuklogic.com.

LeukLogic is run by Tim McGirl, based in the United States. There are no retainers, no lock-in, and no monthly fees; clients keep the code, repo, and accounts in their own name. The site also hosts nine free tools that run entirely in the browser — nothing you put into them is uploaded anywhere. Every page on this site is self-contained: no external scripts, fonts, or analytics.

All nine tools are free and run entirely in your browser — files and data never leave your machine.

## Services

- [Discord and Slack bots](https://leuklogic.com/#getback): FAQ, moderation, tickets, onboarding — most projects $100–$500, days not weeks
- [Automations and scheduled reports](https://leuklogic.com/#getback): scheduled data pulls, scrapers, automated reports, AI triage and routing — $100–$500 band
- [Internal tools and dashboards](https://leuklogic.com/#getback): small web apps and anything with a real interface — larger builds, scoped and quoted flat before anything starts
- [Fast static websites](https://leuklogic.com/#getback): a site that loads instantly — static, fast, no plugins to break
- [Pricing](https://leuklogic.com/#costs): $100–$500 for a bot, automation, or scheduled report; larger builds fixed-price quoted first; the price doesn't move unless the scope does
- [How an engagement works](https://leuklogic.com/#how): email the task → fixed price and delivery date (usually within a day) → $100 Stripe deposit that comes off the project price → build → the rest is due on delivery

## Free tools

- [QuickQuote](https://leuklogic.com/tools/quote/): instant fixed-price quote for a bot, scraper, automation, dashboard, or website — no email required to see the number
- [SwiftStatement](https://leuklogic.com/tools/statement-csv/): convert a bank statement PDF to CSV or Excel in the browser; the statement never uploads anywhere
- [SubScan](https://leuklogic.com/tools/subscription-scanner/): drop a bank or card statement CSV and see every recurring charge ranked by yearly cost, with price hikes flagged
- [DeltaCSV](https://leuklogic.com/tools/csv-diff/): compare two CSVs by a key column you pick — not line order — so a re-sorted export shows only what genuinely changed
- [FlipCSV](https://leuklogic.com/tools/csv-json/): convert CSV to JSON and back, lossless by default with strict RFC 4180 quoting
- [CronText](https://leuklogic.com/tools/cron/): paste a cron expression and get a plain-English description plus the next run times
- [Missed-Call Cost Calculator](https://leuklogic.com/tools/missed-call-calculator/): put in three numbers and see what missed calls cost your business per year, and what a text-back could recover
- [CheckClip](https://leuklogic.com/tools/video-check/): drop a video file and see whether its length, aspect ratio, and file size fit YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Instagram Reels, and X
- [ShrinkKit](https://leuklogic.com/tools/compress/): zip files and shrink images to fit an upload limit, entirely in the browser — nothing is uploaded, and it works offline

## Optional

- [What LeukLogic won't do](https://leuklogic.com/#wontdo): no teams/SLA/24-7 on-call, no mobile apps, no six-month platform rebuilds, no retainers
- [A note on proof](https://leuklogic.com/#proofnote): LeukLogic is new — no client logos, testimonials, or case studies, and it says so plainly rather than inventing them
